title: Distaf's LSN Hoarder Sword
description: A texture pack for custom enchantments on LifeSteal.net (LSN)
body:
Lifesteal.net Custom Texture pack made by Distaf/Tryx  
Some textures/ideas have been given from other people 
Requires specifically version 4.11.2 of Variants-CIT

The pack changes the textures of most tools and armor that have custom enchantments, including textures for other unique items found on the server.

The textures included apply for items like tools, bows and armor, along with textures for enchanted books, ender paper, hearts, etc. Though, the pack does not include textures for items such as spears and tridents YET

Will be updated regullary.
